description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific image upgrade procedures in an OpenWrt build system. It includes functions for checking images, copying configurations, and performing upgrades on Tegra target devices, involving partition checks and image writing commands.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image's partition layout matches the existing device, verifies boot sectors, and prompts for confirmation if layout has changed.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the backup configuration file to the appropriate partition during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the core upgrade process, including partition checks, image writing, and bootloader update on the target disk.
